item.title: Jensen Huang Says He Is Willing to Return as Nvidia CEO
item.description:
Jensen Huang Says He Is Willing to Return as Nvidia CEO

Jensen Huang, who resigned as Nvidia’s CEO last week, has stated he is willing to return to the role if the company’s board of directors requests it. This statement comes after his resignation following reports of two affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy and a direct report.

🔍 Background on Resignation

Huang resigned on Thursday. In a statement, he acknowledged that he “did not live up to the standards expected of everyone at NVIDIA, and I have made serious mistakes in my personal life.” He noted that he created problems for the Board that he deeply regrets and owns his mistakes completely. He is currently committed to cooperating with the Board’s independent investigation.

⚙️ Interim Leadership and Support

Following Huang’s departure, CFO Colette Kress was appointed as interim CEO. However, significant public support for Huang’s return has emerged. More than 193,000 people, including CEOs such as Elon Musk and Tim Sweeney, have signed a letter to “bring Jensen back.” President Trump has also expressed support for Huang’s return, stating that it “certainly isn’t a bad idea.”

💡 Huang’s Statement on Return

Huang said he has seen an “outpouring of calls” from Nvidia’s employees, investors, business partners, and customers asking him to return. He noted that many continue to reach out to him directly as the company navigates complex technology, market, competitive, and geopolitical dynamics. He stated, “If the Board of Directors decides that my return is in the best interest of our shareholders, our employees, the company, and America, I would be honored to answer these calls and return as CEO.”

In the statement, Huang also reflected on his time in the U.S., noting he came to the United States 53 years ago and described becoming an American citizen as one of the greatest gifts and proudest moments of his life. He emphasized that nowhere but in America could a company like NVIDIA be possible.

🚀 Board Stance

Despite the public support, Nvidia’s board reportedly is “not considering” having Huang return. Nvidia did not immediately reply to a request for comment regarding this development.

#Nvidia #JensenHuang #CorporateLeadership #TechNews #CEO

Source: Jensen Huang says he’s willing to return as Nvidia CEO

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Following Spy Allegations and Board Investigation
item.description:
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Following Spy Allegations and Board Investigation

Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO of Nvidia following reports of a Chinese spy plot and the disclosure of multiple extramarital affairs. The resignation, announced on November 12, concludes a series of developments involving national security concerns, board investigations, and a significant decline in the company’s stock value.

🔍 Overview

According to The New York Times, Jensen Huang was targeted by a Chinese spy plot involving Alice Huang, an executive at Singapore-based data center company Megaspeed. While the CEO and company spokespeople characterized the relationship as normal, reports on November 6 indicated that China’s Ministry of State Security specifically recruited Alice Huang to spy on the executive. U.S. officials suspected she was passing information regarding Nvidia’s hardware designs or White House deliberations over trade restrictions directly to Beijing. Megaspeed had previously been investigated by the U.S. Commerce Department for allegedly smuggling advanced AI chips into China.

⚙️ Key Details

The resignation followed several internal disclosures and reports regarding the CEO’s conduct:

  • Admitted Affairs: Jensen Huang admitted to an extramarital affair that raised national security concerns. A second affair was subsequently reported with Kimberly Powell, Nvidia’s vice president of health care and a direct report.
  • Misleading Leadership: According to Reuters, Huang misled general counsel Tim Teter and chief marketing officer Alison Wagonfeld about the nature of his relationship with Alice Huang.
  • Internal Reactions: Bloomberg reported that before resigning, Huang appeared “broken and shattered,” telling associates, “I’m a piece of shit.”
  • Corporate Structure: Huang managed the company with an unusual structure of approximately 60 direct reports and had no established succession plan prior to his departure.

📊 Personnel and Leadership

Name Role
Jensen Huang Resigned CEO and Co-founder
Colette Kress CFO and Interim CEO
Alice Huang Megaspeed Executive and Alleged Spy
Kimberly Powell Vice President of Health Care
Harvey Jones First Board Chair in Nvidia history
Tim Teter General Counsel
Alison Wagonfeld Chief Marketing Officer

📊 Corporate Impact

Following these developments, Nvidia’s stock price fell from an all-time high of $239.24 on October 6 to $162.85 by November 13. The company is currently facing a shareholder lawsuit claiming it deceived investors. Despite the leadership transition, Nvidia continues to manage significant capital, including $99 billion in AI lab investments and plans for $500 billion in data center infrastructure financing.

💡 Why it matters

The appointment of Harvey Jones as the company’s first board chair signals a shift in Nvidia’s corporate governance. Interim CEO Colette Kress described the transition as an “extraordinarily difficult period” for the company. The board has initiated a search for a permanent successor, evaluating both internal and external candidates to lead the company forward.

#Nvidia #JensenHuang #Cybersecurity #Semiconductors #CorporateGovernance

item.title: Google Launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen as New Free Tier and Search Model
item.description:
Google Launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen as New Free Tier and Search Model

On 12th November 2026, Google launched Gemini 4 Hydrogen, the lowest cost member of the Gemini 4 family. Designed as a high-efficiency execution engine, the model is intended for everyday work and to power AI features within Google Search.

⚙️ Key details

Google describes Hydrogen’s position in their model lineup as a tool for fast, disciplined execution.

  • Model Roles: While teams use Carbon and Argon for deep architectural judgment and designing systems, Hydrogen is built for writing code, running tests, and verifying changes.
  • Workflow Integration: Hydrogen can stand alone for everyday tasks or pair with Carbon and Argon in multi-model workflows.
  • Capabilities: In a comparison of image generation, there is a stark difference in pelican quality for Hydrogen compared to its siblings.
Model Primary Function Performance Notes
Gemini 4 Hydrogen Everyday work, code execution, free tier Intended for fast, disciplined execution
Gemini 4 Carbon Architectural judgment, untangling bugs Frontier model
Gemini 4 Argon Architectural judgment, system design Faster responses and lower token spend than Carbon

💰 Pricing

The pricing for the Gemini 4 family is scheduled to change significantly in the coming month:

  • Current Rates: Hydrogen is currently priced at a 25% discount compared to Carbon and Argon. Carbon and Argon are currently the same price.
  • Scheduled Increases: On December 1st, the price of Carbon and Argon is scheduled to double.
  • Future Discount: After December 1st, the Hydrogen price will represent a 75% discount relative to its more capable peers.
  • Market Comparison: At 15x the cost of Claude Haiku 5.5 and GPT-6 Luna (which are both $0.10/$0.50), Hydrogen remains considerably more expensive than competing low-cost models.

🚀 Availability

Hydrogen is available immediately as the new model for Google’s free tier. It is also the specific model designated to power AI features in Google Search.

#Google #Gemini4 #ArtificialIntelligence #MachineLearning #SearchAI

item.title: Nvidia Investigates CEO Jensen Huang Following Acknowledgment of Relationship with Suspected Chinese Agent
item.description:
Nvidia Investigates CEO Jensen Huang Following Acknowledgment of Relationship with Suspected Chinese Agent

On Sunday, Nvidia announced that its Board of Directors has initiated an independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang. The investigation follows reports regarding Huang’s relationship with Alice Huang, an AI executive and agent of the Chinese government.

🔍 Overview

In a memo sent to Nvidia employees, Jensen Huang acknowledged having an affair with Alice Huang, who is identified as a suspected Chinese spy. Huang stated that he was unfaithful to his wife and that his actions hurt his children, taking full responsibility for the situation.

⚙️ Key Details

The investigation involves several key entities and concerns as outlined in company communications:

Entity Role / Description
Jensen Huang CEO of NVIDIA who acknowledged an affair with a suspected Chinese agent
Alice Huang AI executive and agent of the Chinese government
NVIDIA Board of Directors The body that initiated an independent investigation into national security concerns
  • Independent Investigation: The Board of Directors launched the probe in response to national security concerns raised in news reports.
  • Cooperation: Huang stated he supports the investigation and will cooperate fully.
  • Commitment to Security: Huang expressed his commitment to protecting NVIDIA and supporting America’s national security, noting that he is proud to be an American.
  • Professional Responsibility: Huang acknowledged that he has fallen short of his responsibility to serve the company and be worthy of trust.

💡 Why it matters

Huang described leading NVIDIA as the privilege of his life and stated he is fully committed to the company. While acknowledging that an apology cannot undo his actions, he expressed hope that he can earn back the confidence of employees over time. He also requested privacy for his family, stating they bear no responsibility for his choices.

#Nvidia #JensenHuang #NationalSecurity #AI #TechNews
